title: Cocktail Drink Watercolor Illustration
author: Sunny Design
description:
This is a watercolor cocktail clip art bundle. The clipart has a transparent background that allows you to place this clip art frame behind any color background. It will be perfect for your scrapbooking projects, stickers, party invitations, greeting cards, paper products, and much more.
You will receive a zip folder that includes PNG files with transparent backgrounds with high-resolution 300dpi :
Included in this package:
– 1 ZIP file
– 10 transparent PNG images – 300 dpi
Thank you!
